scope: Offline source packaging and supplementary launcher provenance; no installation
current_limitation: The source archive includes launcher return research and a pinned source fetch tool, but does not embed the independently verified base launcher checkout. Reproduction requires the pinned checkout to be fetched and verified; the nested local archive is not a Git repository root and cannot establish revision provenance.
tool_change: Launcher release verifier scopes Git safe.directory to the reviewed checkout using per-command configuration; no global Git setting is changed.
validation: Eight verifier tests and four launcher source archive tests pass, including rejection of a nested non-repository archive and scoped Git configuration.
limits: Supplementary provenance checks are not full kit validation, reproducible binary proof, target admission or console gameplay evidence.
